snippet.title: Tesera - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Tesera is a survival sandbox game with a unique sci-fi setting and post-apocalyptic elements. An exciting journey through an unpredictable world full of raiders, unusual alien creatures, autonomous endoskeletons, and robots left behind by a dead civilization awaits you.

Disclaimer: Everything you’re about to see is pre-alpha gameplay footage and does not represent the final quality of the game.

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3258010/Tesera/
🌐 Website / Browser Version: https://tesera.io
📌 Check out our development roadmap here: https://landing.tesera.io/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/8C72nfZ3WR
